pipelines.name: nadir_camera_rtsp_cpu
pipelines.pipeline: rtspsrc location=rtsp://host.docker.internal:8554/uav-1/nadir latency=100 ! rtph264depay ! h264parse ! decodebin3 ! videoconvert ! video/x-raw,format=NV12,width=416,height=416 ! gvadetect device=CPU name=detection model-instance-id=instcpu0 ! queue ! gvapython module=/home/pipeline-server/gvapython/telemetry-overlay-uavsdk.py class=DrawDynamicText function=process_frame arg=["UAVSDK-RTSP-CPU"] ! gvametaconvert add-empty-results=true name=metaconvert ! gvametapublish name=destination ! appsink name=appsink

pipelines.name: forward_camera_rtsp_gpu
pipelines.pipeline: rtspsrc location=rtsp://host.docker.internal:8554/uav-1/forward latency=100 protocols=tcp ! rtph264depay ! h264parse ! decodebin3 ! videoconvert ! video/x-raw,format=NV12,width=416,height=416 ! gvadetect device=GPU model-instance-id=instgpu0 inference-region=full-frame inference-interval=1 batch-size=1 nireq=1 ie-config="GPU_THROUGHPUT_STREAMS=1" threshold=0.4 name=detection ! gvapython module=/home/pipeline-server/gvapython/telemetry-overlay-uavsdk.py class=DrawDynamicText function=process_frame arg=["UAVSDK-RTSP-GPU"] ! queue ! gvametaconvert add-empty-results=true name=metaconvert ! queue ! gvafpscounter ! appsink name=destination
